games.name: DON'T BLINK
games.desc:
👁️ DON’T BLINK is a 1vAll or 2vAll survival horror game inspired by Doctor Who, where survivors must escape deadly Angels and survive until the round timer ends.

As a survivor, you MUST control your blinks, keep your eyes on the Angels, and never look away at the wrong time. Every blink gives them a chance to move closer. Survive the round before they reach you.

As an Angel, you must wipe out all the survivors before the timer runs out.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: THIS GAME IS NOT FOR SALE. BEWARE OF PEOPLE IMPERSONATING ME OR PRETENDING TO OWN THE GAME.

Run, fight, and outlast the most chaotic and epic disasters ever! Use everything to your advantage, earn points, and do whatever it takes to survive. Good luck, and don't die!

• 🏹 Weapons: Melee, Ranged, and Explosives to fight back against NPC disasters!
• 🛡️ Utility: Speed Coils, Healing Items, and tools to outsmart death.
• 🍔 Fun Items: Burgers, Drinks, Ducks, and more to survive with style.

• 🌪️ Pure Chaos: Random disasters mixed with unpredictable round modifiers!

👍 Leave a Like and Favorite if you enjoy the game! It helps a lot!

games.name: Brawlers 👊
games.desc:
